architecture.editorial_thesis: In 2026-W35, open-weight competition centered on architectural efficiency: large MoE releases and previews paired relatively low active-parameter counts with increasingly explicit serving-efficiency goals, while the agent coding plane reorganized around portable sessions, agent-native forges, and deterministic guardrails; flagship claims and governance moves remain inside explicit evidence bounds.
architecture_goals: Center the verified open-weight release cluster without promoting relayed specs to fact
Show the agent tooling plane reorganization with trust questions explicit
Pair flagship claims with their caveats (benchmark slices, vendor figures)
Ground serving economics and regional open progress in first-party authority
Contrast safety evidence with governance models without equating them
